name: Desert Wind Zen Group
reason: Too thin: its own site (www.desertwindzen.org, five Squarespace pages; robots.txt puts Claude agents in the * group, so allowed) offers one Monday evening sitting and a Zen Day every other month (next 27 Dec 2026), both held at the Albuquerque Insight Meditation Center, on a single schedule page; no premises, resources or videos of its own (about 1-2 items). Teacher Tony Sager JDPSN (not on Spiritpedia).
